raw_segments.text: Apollo, to you, Athena's mighty counsel court, justly for justice will I plead, even
I the prophet God, nor cheat you by one word.
For never spake I from my prophet's seat one word of man, of woman, or of state, save
what the father of Olympian gods commanded unto me.
I read you then, but think you of my plea, how strong it stands, and follow the decree
For oaths prevail not over Zeus command.
